latest.title: A Note on Sphere Packing Bounds for Tuple Lattice Sieving
latest.abstract: A finite set of unit vectors is $k$-irreducible if every signed sum of between two and $k$ distinct elements has norm greater than one. Let $\mathcal{R}_k$ be the maximal asymptotic rate of such sets, and let $κ(α)$ be the maximal asymptotic rate of spherical codes with pairwise inner products at most $α$. For $k \ge 2$ we show: \begin{align} \mathcal{R}_k \le \min_{1 \le r \le \lfloor k/2 \rfloor} \frac{1}{r} \, κ\!\left(1 - \frac{1}{2r}\right) \, . \end{align} Combining this with standard sphere packing bounds, for large $k$ we obtain an almost-tight asymptotic comparison with the known lower bounds: \begin{align} \left(\tfrac{1}{2}-o(1)\right) \, \frac{\log_2 k}{k} \le \mathcal{R}_k \le (1 + o(1)) \, \frac{\log_2 k}{k} \, . \end{align}
latest.workSummary: 用球码界控制 k 不可约单位向量集的渐近率，得到接近下界的大 k 估计。
latest.breakthrough: 缩小 tuple 格筛几何参数的渐近间隙。
latest.limitations: 仍存在常数因子间隙，不能称精确渐近常数。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
latest.priorityReason: 偏密码算法的离散几何参数，和主线关联弱，后读。
